channel.title: Version 9.5 :: Hugo Relearn Theme
channel.description: 9.5.0 (2026-10-31) Enhancements [feature][change] cards: restyle the hover of linked cards #1380 [feature] search: load the index only once a search is about to happen #1373 [feature] theme: improve build performance #1372 [feature] mermaid: draw the graphs of the print version one at a time #1362 [feature][change] topbar: show button titles depending on the screen width #1359 [feature] image: set a default size in image effects #1358 Fixes [bug] a11y: let the tab key continue from where was clicked #1383 [bug] a11y: make the menu expander a click target of its own #1382 [bug] cards: make the content of linked cards usable #1381 [bug] table: draw all borders in Firefox #1368 [bug] button: center the icon without making the button taller #1366 [bug] print: put all graphs and specs on paper in Firefox and Safari #1364 [bug] print: draw Mermaid and OpenAPI with the colors of the print variant #1363 [bug] theme: make elements use letter-spacing variable as expected #1357 Maintenance [task] search: update lunr-languages to 1.24.0 #1385 [task] theme: tidy up the ids of the skip link and the search page #1384 [task] theme: stop reading reserved front matter via .Params #1377 [task] theme: prepare for Hugo’s new template structure #1376 [task][change] mermaid: update to 12.2.0 #1375 [task] theme: use Language.Name instead of deprecated Language.Lang #1374 [task][change] math: deprecate delimiters in shortcode and KaTeX options in math #1370 [task] theme: fix the download URL of Roboto Flex #1369 [task][change] button: deprecate iconposition parameter #1367 [task] print: use the standard print-color-adjust property #1365 [task] theme: switch all layout widths by the width classes #1361 [task] theme: adapt to plainify changes of Hugo 0.169 #1360
